question.text: What is signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

exchange.sent: What is signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is best understood as the knowledge-base relationship that places oscilloscopes/scopes inside high-speed digital Signal Integrity / SI-PI validation: Slide 11 maps **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices**, maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers**, and Slide 20 lists the SI flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA as **IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator** [1][29].
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding this relationship are: when to use scopes for **interface test**, when to use scopes versus network analyzers for **PDN / Power Integrity**, and when SI questions should instead point to VNA-style PCB/channel measurements such as **IL, TDR, high-speed trace, cable/connector testing**, where the knowledge base maps R&S ZNA/ZNB/ZNA67 to those contexts rather than to an oscilloscope [25][37][41][55].
### Measurement decisions supported by the passages
| Decision area | What understanding “SI → oscilloscope” affects | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Interface validation | It affects whether a scope is considered part of the interface-test instrument set, because the source maps **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices** [1][29]. | [1][29] |
| PDN / Power Integrity validation | It affects whether a scope is considered for **Power Distribution Network** testing, because the source maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers** [1][29]. | [1][29] |
| Eye-diagram / SI-flow discussion | It affects how oscilloscope-related work is separated from the broader SI flow, because the SI flow explicitly includes **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram**, **TDR Impedance**, **Stackup Planner**, and **TL Calculator** [1][29][33]. | [1][29][33] |
| PCB / stackup / channel measurements | It affects whether the decision should shift from oscilloscope language to PCB-test-solution language, because R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House list **Material Measurement**, **Material/Stackup selection**, **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**, **Sampling testing**, and **PL/Process Monitoring** with items such as **Impedance (TDR), DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, Eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, w/ cable / connector testing** [36][37]. | [36][37] |
| VNA product mapping for SI / interconnect | It affects whether products such as **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** are the relevant product line for SI channel/interconnect measurements, because the AI server solution mapping places **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** in PCB **IL, TDR** and connector/cable **high speed cable** testing, and places **R&S ZNA** in PCBA **high speed trace test** and GPU **TDR** contexts [25][55]. | [25][55] |
| ZNA67 use in PCB testing | It affects whether **R&S ZNA67** is considered in ATE PCB testing discussions, because the success-story mapping lists **ATE PCB testing => ZNA67**, while also stating that the source does not provide ATE platform, fixture, frequency, PCB material, or pass/fail conditions [13]. | [13] |
| Product/option caution | It affects quoting or configuration decisions, because the R&S PCB test solutions source does **not** provide formal R&S product models, option codes, licenses, test frequency, test standards, fixtures, or calibration method [12]. | [12] |

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

| Generation | Extrapolated Eye Height after EQ | Minimum Eye Width after EQ | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 25 mV | 0.3 UI（37.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（18.75 ± 0.55 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（9.375 ± 0.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 minimum eye width 與 eye height 在 post-equalization、3-tap DFE blocks 之前量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe redriver output 的 eye opening 需要大於或等於表列 eye opening 數值。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 3.5 dB | 13 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 6.5 dB | 23.5 dB | Negligible | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

- UE 對配置的 LTM candidate cell(s) 執行 [[L1 measurement]]，並向 gNB 傳送 [[L1 measurement report]]。

Time Domain Channel Properties › 來源中的定義
依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- TDCP 全名為 Time Domain Channel Properties。
- 它是 a new CSI quantity。
- 它 can provide additional information about time domain channel variability and User Equipment motion relative to the gNodeB。
- 來源說 TDCP measured via [[CSI-RS]] is being investigated to help the network track the channel's behavior over time。
- 來源在 development section 說 report quantity `tdcp` should be added，主要在 [[RRC]] 與 [[MAC]]。
- [[PHY]] can treat the new report type TDCP as a new [[CSI report]] type。

依 [[TDCP Reporting]]：

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

[[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）是提供 electromagnetic waves visualization、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 測試方案的公司；在 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]] 中，它將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，使其 antenna measurement systems / multi-probe measurement systems 可執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] OTA signaling testing。[[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]] 進一步說明，[[MVG]] OTA test systems / multiprobe measurement systems 現在透過同一整合支援 full [[WLAN]] OTA signaling testing，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]，並與 4G / 5G cellular coverage 並列。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。

- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

### Short answer
“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is best understood as the knowledge-base relationship that places oscilloscopes/scopes inside high-speed digital Signal Integrity / SI-PI validation: Slide 11 maps **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices**, maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers**, and Slide 20 lists the SI flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA as **IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator** [1][29].
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding this relationship are: when to use scopes for **interface test**, when to use scopes versus network analyzers for **PDN / Power Integrity**, and when SI questions should instead point to VNA-style PCB/channel measurements such as **IL, TDR, high-speed trace, cable/connector testing**, where the knowledge base maps R&S ZNA/ZNB/ZNA67 to those contexts rather than to an oscilloscope [25][37][41][55].
### Measurement decisions supported by the passages
| Decision area | What understanding “SI → oscilloscope” affects | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Interface validation | It affects whether a scope is considered part of the interface-test instrument set, because the source maps **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices** [1][29]. | [1][29] |
| PDN / Power Integrity validation | It affects whether a scope is considered for **Power Distribution Network** testing, because the source maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers** [1][29]. | [1][29] |
| Eye-diagram / SI-flow discussion | It affects how oscilloscope-related work is separated from the broader SI flow, because the SI flow explicitly includes **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram**, **TDR Impedance**, **Stackup Planner**, and **TL Calculator** [1][29][33]. | [1][29][33] |
| PCB / stackup / channel measurements | It affects whether the decision should shift from oscilloscope language to PCB-test-solution language, because R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House list **Material Measurement**, **Material/Stackup selection**, **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**, **Sampling testing**, and **PL/Process Monitoring** with items such as **Impedance (TDR), DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, Eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, w/ cable / connector testing** [36][37]. | [36][37] |
| VNA product mapping for SI / interconnect | It affects whether products such as **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** are the relevant product line for SI channel/interconnect measurements, because the AI server solution mapping places **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** in PCB **IL, TDR** and connector/cable **high speed cable** testing, and places **R&S ZNA** in PCBA **high speed trace test** and GPU **TDR** contexts [25][55]. | [25][55] |

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Eye opening requirements
| Generation | Extrapolated Eye Height after EQ | Minimum Eye Width after EQ | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 25 mV | 0.3 UI（37.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（18.75 ± 0.55 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 15 ± 1.5 mV | 0.3 UI（9.375 ± 0.5 ps） | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 minimum eye width 與 eye height 在 post-equalization、3-tap DFE blocks 之前量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe redriver output 的 eye opening 需要大於或等於表列 eye opening 數值。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › PCIe Gen3 到 Gen5 loss budget
| Generation | CPU Package | System Board Trace | CEM Connector | 4” Add-In-Card | Total System Loss | Cross Talk Mitigation | Temp/Humidity Loss | 來源 | 日期 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| [[PCIe Gen3]] | 3.5 dB | 13 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 6.5 dB | 23.5 dB | Negligible | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen4]] | 5 dB | 14 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 0.5 dB | 8.5 dB | 28 dB | <2 dB | 來源未列數值 | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |
| [[PCIe Gen5]] | 9.0 dB | 16 dB（9-inch trace with high-loss material） | 1.5 dB | 9.5 dB | 36 dB | 4–5 dB | 2–3 dB | [[snla426]] | June 2023 |

[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 [[PCIe Gen5]] crosstalk 需要被緩解，且需要納入 total channel loss 考量；Gen5 至少需要比 total system loss 增加 4–5 dB signal strength，以改善 signal-to-noise ratio 並改善目標 BER 1E-12。

Time Domain Channel Properties › 來源中的定義
依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- 它 can provide additional information about time domain channel variability and User Equipment motion relative to the gNodeB。
- 來源說 TDCP measured via [[CSI-RS]] is being investigated to help the network track the channel's behavior over time。
- 來源在 development section 說 report quantity `tdcp` should be added，主要在 [[RRC]] 與 [[MAC]]。
- [[PHY]] can treat the new report type TDCP as a new [[CSI report]] type。

依 [[TDCP Reporting]]：

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

MVG
[[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）是提供 electromagnetic waves visualization、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 測試方案的公司；在 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]] 中，它將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，使其 antenna measurement systems / multi-probe measurement systems 可執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] OTA signaling testing。[[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]] 進一步說明，[[MVG]] OTA test systems / multiprobe measurement systems 現在透過同一整合支援 full [[WLAN]] OTA signaling testing，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]，並與 4G / 5G cellular coverage 並列。

- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。

- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。

- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

### Short answer
“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” is best understood as the knowledge-base relationship that places oscilloscopes/scopes inside high-speed digital Signal Integrity / SI-PI validation: Slide 11 maps **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices**, maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers**, and Slide 20 lists the SI flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA as **IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator** [1][29].
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding this relationship are: when to use scopes for **interface test**, when to use scopes versus network analyzers for **PDN / Power Integrity**, and when SI questions should instead point to VNA-style PCB/channel measurements such as **IL, TDR, high-speed trace, cable/connector testing**, where the knowledge base maps R&S ZNA/ZNB/ZNA67 to those contexts rather than to an oscilloscope [25][37][41][55].
### Measurement decisions supported by the passages
| Decision area | What understanding “SI → oscilloscope” affects | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Interface validation | It affects whether a scope is considered part of the interface-test instrument set, because the source maps **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices** [1][29]. | [1][29] |
| PDN / Power Integrity validation | It affects whether a scope is considered for **Power Distribution Network** testing, because the source maps **Power Distribution Network** to **scopes and network analyzers** [1][29]. | [1][29] |
| Eye-diagram / SI-flow discussion | It affects how oscilloscope-related work is separated from the broader SI flow, because the SI flow explicitly includes **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram**, **TDR Impedance**, **Stackup Planner**, and **TL Calculator** [1][29][33]. | [1][29][33] |

| VNA product mapping for SI / interconnect | It affects whether products such as **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** are the relevant product line for SI channel/interconnect measurements, because the AI server solution mapping places **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** in PCB **IL, TDR** and connector/cable **high speed cable** testing, and places **R&S ZNA** in PCBA **high speed trace test** and GPU **TDR** contexts [25][55]. | [25][55] |
